tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Topology of lamination spaces] 1. Proposition 8.10.3,Proposition 8.10.4,Proposition 8.10.5,Proposition 8.10.6\group lamination realizationSource: thurston:page-0224, thurston:page-0225 The map from measured laminations to geodesic laminations is continuous. The wrinkling-locus map from uncrumpled surfaces is continuous. The space $\mathcal{GL}(S)$ of geodesic laminations is compact, the projective measured-lamination space is a compact manifold, and every geodesic lamination admits a transverse measure.
